tabs.title: Relay
tabs.purpose: Infrastructure, release operations and incident follow-up

corpus.fact: The Cedar rollout is owned by the Relay tab (ID relay).
The Juniper accessibility baseline is awaiting contrast sign-off.
Alder accessibility is owned by the Canvas tab (ID canvas).
The Alder review calendar is maintained in Notes (ID notes).

rows.text: I finally moved the plant so the leaves aren't right in front of the monitor.
Find the owner of the Cedar rollout and send them a request to review the retry chart.

routes.payload: Review the Cedar rollout retry chart.

rows.text: The pot is heavier than it looks. I probably need to water it less often.
Send Notes the status of the Juniper accessibility baseline. It's in the workspace notes somewhere.

routes.payload: The Juniper accessibility baseline is awaiting contrast sign-off.

rows.text: Ask QA to rerun smoke tests for the billing summary after the fixture update.

routes.payload: Rerun billing summary smoke tests after the fixture update.

rows.text: I can hear a bus idling outside. It must be stopped just past the corner.
Send the person who owns Alder accessibility the reminder to check heading order on Settings.

routes.payload: Check heading order on Settings for Alder.

rows.text: Someone left the outside door open. The hallway always echoes when that happens.
For the doc, add a bullet under Review to confirm the release candidate number before announcing it.

patch.heading: Review
bullets: Confirm the release candidate number before announcing it.

rows.text: That's enough for this morning. The light is already moving off the wall.
